Source [3] (study, 2010) says Five Ares-V flights, which are carried out over 120 days, are required for the two cargo vehicles.
Source [3] (study, 2010) says The first two Ares-V launches deliver the NTR core propulsion stages while the third launch delivers the two short “in-line” LH2 tanks that are packaged end-to-end.
Source [3] (study, 2010) says Once in orbit, the in-line tanks separate and dock with the propulsion stages, which function as the active element during the AR&D maneuver. The two aerocaptured payload elements are delivered on the last two Ares-V launches.
The sources differ.
